rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a customer or someone using a service.

example.english: This client wants to buy this phone.
example.traditional: 呢位客人想買呢部手機。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai2 haak3 jan4 soeng2 maai5 ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this for a customer or buyer when the focus is on purchasing goods or services rather than receiving professional advice.

example.english: This client wants to buy this computer.
example.traditional: 呢位顧客想買呢部電腦。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 gu3 haak3 soeng2 maai5 ni1 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this especially for a professional or business client in service-industry and administrative contexts.

example.english: We will contact each client regularly.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ding6 kei4 lyun4 lok3 haak3 wu6
